label: Final copy step of length-3 sequences (plus weak late-copy tail)
explanation: Copy-phase only; never active in the original or delimiter phase. Its core is the last copy step of length-3 sequences (t=5, outputting orig(2), input orig(1)). It fires there on essentially every such sequence (dev precision 0.9996) at by far the largest magnitudes: about 78% of top-quartile activations and 56% of activation mass. The other ~80% of activations, which are weak, fall on the last one or two copy steps (to_go<=1) of longer sequences, mostly L=4 and L>=6. They are almost absent for L=5 and lean toward certain input tokens (r, h, l, 0, n), but no clean rule picks them out: (phase==2)&(to_go<=1) has recall 0.84 and mass recall 0.93 but precision 0.05. It never fires on early copy steps (to_go>=6).
